recommended.title: Experiment 1a: can a child HWND composite beneath the webview
recommended.acceptance: The pass/fail experiment docs/DESKTOP_PLAYBACK.md section 10 specifies is executed on real Windows hardware and its result recorded, because D1 -- the entire choice of Tauri -- rests on it and it has never been run. A sibling child HWND must render beneath a WebView2 whose DefaultBackgroundColor has alpha 0, with the web UI visible above it. REQUIRED: the result is recorded as a fact with the Windows build, GPU and WebView2 runtime version it was observed on, not as an expectation. REQUIRED: if it FAILS, stop and report rather than working around it -- section 11 names this as one of the specific facts that would reverse D1, and the honest outcome of a failed experiment is a reversed decision, not a hack that makes the demo look right. THIS TASK CANNOT BE COMPLETED WITHOUT THE COMMANDER'S WINDOWS MACHINE and its real-device half belongs in LAST_MILE the moment the code is ready.
